blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-180-1188 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 044-2816-7777 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email call.centre@sc.com from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.sc.com/in and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sc.mobilebanking.in | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/sc-bank-in/id1354682009
